name: dsul Context
description: Chat with your OpenClaw agent from dsul's Ask, and a signed wake that starts a run the moment you hand the agent a dsul item. The agent's planner tools come from dsul's MCP server (openclaw mcp add).

dsulUrl.description: Base URL of your dsul deployment (e.g. https://dsul.yourdomain.com)

apiKey.description: Your personal dsul API key. `openclaw dsul-context setup` fills it in after you authorize at dsul's /connect page.

publicUrl.description: Your gateway's public URL (e.g. https://your-machine.ts.net) — registers …/plugins/dsul/chat for chat from Ask and …/plugins/dsul/webhook for the hand-off wake

agentId.description: OpenClaw agent id that answers in dsul's Ask (default: main)

id.description: Optional alias for agent id if agentId is not set

webhookSecret.description: HMAC secret dsul signs events with. Required for the hand-off wake: without it the wake is off and an unsigned request never starts a run. `openclaw dsul-context setup` adds one.
